items.name: Pure Black
items.role: the brand. Every primary CTA, every black pill, every link in the nav, and every solid icon. There is no other "brand color."

items.name: Ink Deep
items.role: pressed-state black for the primary pill — a single notch below pure.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: the page itself. Nearly every surface in the system.

items.name: Soft Surface
items.role: install-snippet pill background, search pill, secondary chip backgrounds, alternating row fill where one is needed.

items.name: Surface Dark
items.role: the dark "Max" pricing card and dark CTA strips. The single inverted surface in the system.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1px card border, divider line above footer, divider between FAQ rows.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: rare slightly stronger divider where extra separation is needed (e.g., between unrelated FAQ groups).

items.name: Ink
items.role: all headlines, primary nav links, button text on light surfaces, prices on pricing cards.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: list-item text and disabled-state secondary copy.

items.name: Body
items.role: default body color for paragraph copy, FAQ answers, footer link text — the system's most-used text color after pure black.

items.name: Mute
items.role: caption text, command-line "comment" gray inside terminal mockups, lowest-emphasis utility text.

items.name: On Dark Mute
items.role: ): secondary copy inside the dark "Max" pricing card.

items.name: Focus Ring
items.role: ): translucent blue browser-default focus ring around interactive elements. The only blue in the system.
